question: In a certain code language, ‘PARK’ is written as ‘QCSM’ and ‘FREE’ is written as ‘GTFG’. How will ‘FAME’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

‘PARK’ is written as ‘QCSM’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f439a80ce08cc9ea5591455fe12883b443252150a8382bdbea1ff76fd67b1c1f.png] 

and

‘FREE’ is written as ‘GTFG’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243aeab818bfb5550acb039364e2cd4c15572ce5a2f6c3cc67955bb2c55b9398.png] 

Similarly,

‘FAME’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5684004fd35634ad3fe33a60c1365bf157d65cdba1e019ff380f5c5490bbf05a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GCNG".**
